title: A Globally Conservative Compact Framework for Conservation Laws: Fourth-Order Schemes with Enhanced Resolution and Stability
summary: The compact finite difference method is a powerful tool for discretizing conservation laws, owing to its inherent flexibility in developing high-resolution and highly stable schemes. In this paper, we propose a framework for the design of genuine globally conservative compact finite difference schemes, which addresses a critical requirement in conservation laws.
